subject: Automatically put names to the tree branches

messages.author: b7a46c53a2fcd90c
messages.subject: Automatically put names to the tree branches
parts:
Hello,

I am curious if it is possible to automatically name the tree nodes? Say you give name "A" to the node3 and ggtree will automatically name the child nodes as A1 and A2, then, A1a, A1b, and A2a, A2b to their child nodes, etc. down to the tips. This is the way people annotate human Y chromosomal and mitochondrial DNA tree, but they do it manually, if I am not wrong. Then, with every new sample it is necessary to change all the annotations down from the node where the sample coalesce. Now imagine if you should add many samples, then it becomes disaster. Every time you do this annoying work, then you have to do it again and again. It will be quite essential if all this will be done automatically.

Best,
Hovhannes
